seed.name: Urbi et Orbi
seed.text: To the city and the world. That is the whole greeting. Dummy feed. Not official Vatican. Not a meme.

seed.name: The Square
seed.text: The square is a public room. Cameras, pilgrims, pigeons. Talk like you are standing in it, not dunking from a couch.

seed.name: Encyclical Desk
seed.text: Read the letter slowly. Headlines flatten it. Dummy desk. The office writes on purpose, not for the cycle.

seed.name: White Smoke
seed.text: White smoke is a process with rules. Civic knowledge, not a betting market. Dummy, not a prediction.

seed.name: Charity First
seed.text: Hospitals and bread before the argument. If the thread cannot hold that, it is not this room.

seed.name: Holy See Desk
seed.text: The See is an office. We will not invent a sitting name as live news on a dummy feed. Talk about the chair.

seed.name: Keys
seed.text: Keys in a purple square is a mark, not a coat of arms. We are not the press office. Dummy rehearsal.

seed.name: Colonnade
seed.text: Bernini built a pair of arms. The architecture is the metaphor. Dummy postcard from the square.

seed.name: Quiet Collection
seed.text: A collection that does not need a camera. Charity first. Dummy, not a fundraiser.

seed.name: Bells
seed.text: Bells keep time for people who still look up. Dummy note. The city is in the greeting.

seed.name: Pilgrim Thread
seed.text: If you walked a long way, you get the benefit of the doubt. Be kind in the square. Dummy etiquette.

seed.name: Not a Homily
seed.text: Mass is elsewhere. This is a room for talking about the office and the letters. Dummy. Not X.com.

seed.name: Footnotes
seed.text: The poor are in the footnotes if you actually read. Dummy desk. Culture war is a bad lector.

seed.name: Sede
seed.text: No conspiracy threads. The process is public enough. Dummy feed. Go outside if you need a conclave rumor.

seed.name: World
seed.text: Orbi means the world. Include people who are not already in your parish group chat. Dummy, still the point.

seed.name: City
seed.text: Urbi means the city. Rome first, then everyone. The greeting still works if you are not there.
